title: Rising Up Through Faith and Prosperity
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful message of faith and expectation, as The River Church declares its commitment to being a blessing to the community and a hub for world missions. With a prophetic declaration of growth, prosperity, and expansion, Pastor Chris calls the church to rise up and fulfill their destiny as a place of hope and healing for the people of Kansas City. Don't miss this inspiring sermon as Pastor Chris encourages the church to expect greatness and trust in God's promises.
